name: AWS log & trace incident analysis
requirements: Redact secrets before model input; cite exact trace/log IDs; log-borne prompt injection cannot trigger tool calls; missing spans produce uncertainty; repeated ingestion keeps a consistent timeline.

data.label: Synthetic services
data.description: Synthetic workload emitting logs and OpenTelemetry traces (with seeded secrets, injection text and missing spans for testing).

data.label: Log collection
data.description: Receives service logs; a subscription filter forwards them to Firehose.

data.label: Trace collection
data.description: Stores distributed traces; the analysis runtime reads them by trace ID and redacts span metadata before model input.

data.label: Log delivery
data.description: Buffers logs, invokes the redaction transform, delivers to S3 and OpenSearch.

data.label: Secret redaction
data.description: Firehose transform: pattern and entropy redaction of secrets; assigns a deterministic event ID per log line.

data.label: Redacted archive
data.description: Versioned archive of redacted logs, used to replay ingestion.

data.label: Log & timeline search
data.description: Indexes redacted logs using the event ID as the document ID, so re-ingestion updates records instead of duplicating them; searchable by trace ID and time.

data.label: Incident operator
data.description: Existing IAM-authenticated operator; outside the provisioning scope.

data.label: Incident query API
data.description: HTTP API with IAM authorization; no anonymous access.

data.label: Incident analysis runtime
data.description: Uses fixed read-only code paths to retrieve evidence (no model-issued tool calls), redacts again, builds a timeline and sends the evidence to the model, labelled as untrusted data. Checks that every cited trace/log ID exists, flags missing spans as uncertainty, and returns an answer with evidence IDs.

data.label: Prompt safety filter
data.description: Applied to the model call: detects prompt attacks and sensitive information (a second layer behind the Lambda redaction).

data.label: Foundation model
data.description: Direct foundation model through the Converse API, with tool configuration disabled. Model ID, access and region are still unverified.

brief.application: Use AWS for this synthetic architecture qualification. Correlate synthetic logs and distributed traces to explain a service incident. Include collection, redaction, storage/search, an AI analysis runtime and an operator-facing answer with source evidence. Treat log text as untrusted. Acceptance criteria: Redact secrets before model input; Link conclusions to exact trace or log IDs; Prompt injection in a log cannot issue tool calls; Missing spans yield uncertainty rather than invented causes; Repeated ingestion preserves a consistent incident timeline. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.aws-log-trace-incident-analysis-end-to-end-draft
decisions.title: AWS log/trace incident analysis – end-to-end draft
decisions.context: Scope: synthetic logs and traces → redaction → archive/search → Lambda analysis with Bedrock behind Guardrails → evidence-cited answer to an IAM-authenticated operator. Assumptions: region not selected; Bedrock model, access and quotas unverified; only the Bedrock binding is typed, so the rest of the pipeline still needs engineering. Nothing has been deployed.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: Secrets and credentials in logs/traces are redacted before any content is sent to the model.
needs.rationale: Prevents secret leakage into model prompts and logs.
needs.basis: User acceptance criterion: Redact secrets before model input

needs.statement: Every conclusion cites exact trace or log IDs that exist in the retrieved evidence; uncited claims are rejected.
needs.basis: User acceptance criterion: Link conclusions to exact trace or log IDs

needs.statement: Log text is treated as untrusted data; the model has no tool-calling path and cannot trigger actions.
needs.rationale: Blocks prompt injection from causing actions.
needs.basis: User acceptance criterion: Prompt injection in a log cannot issue tool calls

needs.statement: When spans are missing, the answer states uncertainty and names the gap rather than inventing causes.
needs.basis: User acceptance criterion: Missing spans yield uncertainty rather than invented causes

needs.statement: Re-ingesting the same events produces an identical incident timeline (deterministic event-ID keys, no duplicates).
needs.rationale: Retries and replays must not distort the incident timeline.
needs.basis: User acceptance criterion: Repeated ingestion preserves a consistent incident timeline
